key_features: KIDS BACKPACK FOR SCHOOL & DAYCARE: Sized for toddlers, preschoolers, and kindergartners ages 3 and up - the right fit for little shoulders carrying snacks, a tablet, and a lunch box to school, daycare, or weekend trips.

SCHOOL READY ORGANIZATION: A padded tablet sleeve, large zip-closure front pocket, zip stash pocket, and two expandable side bottle sleeves keep folders, snacks, and water bottles organized and easy to grab on the way out the door.

BUILT FOR REAL DAYS: Made from easy-to-clean polyester with padded, adjustable shoulder straps and reinforced stitching - wipes clean with a damp cloth after the spilled juice and lunchroom messes that come with the school year.

GIFT-READY FOR BACK-TO-SCHOOL & BIRTHDAYS: A thoughtful pick for the first day of school, birthday gifts, and holidays - pairs with our Hadley lunch box, Summit bottles, and Porter bento box (all sold separately) for a coordinated kids set.
